title: Berlin Club Dress Codes - Quick Summary
items: **Almost no Berlin club publishes a dress code.** Berghain, Tresor, Sisyphos, ://about blank, RSO and Kater all run selection at the door with nothing written down. The one thing you can prepare is the thing nobody tells you to prepare.
**All black is a habit, not a rule.** It is what the room wears, so it reads as belonging. It is not a password, and it will not carry you past a door that has already read you as a tourist group.

**The door is mostly reading everything except your clothes:** how many of you there are, how loud you are, how drunk you are, whether you are on your phone, and whether you can say which night you came for.

**KitKatClub is the exception that proves it.** It is the only well-known Berlin door with a published, enforced dress rule, and street clothes are refused there. Everywhere else, dressing up is a guess.
**Matrix at Warschauer Straße is the other exception,** running a normal commercial smart-casual door under the U-Bahn arches. If you want a club where the outfit is the whole test, that is the one.

**Your phone camera gets a sticker at most serious doors.** Berghain, Tresor, Sisyphos, ://about blank, Kater and Renate all cover the lenses. Tresor’s own guest information says photography inside means you are removed from the premises.
**Tresor’s cloakroom is self-service and needs a charged phone with NFC switched on.** That is a genuine practical trap for a visitor with a flat battery at 02:00.
**Watergate is gone.** It closed for good at the end of 2024 after 22 years on the Spree at the Oberbaumbrücke. Guides and old blog posts still send people there.
**Renate nearly went the same way and did not.** It announced closure for the end of 2025, then secured its lease in December 2025 and stayed open. Kater Blau also became simply Kater in August 2025.

**Sunday afternoon is the underrated arrival.** Half these doors are still running from Friday, the queues have thinned, and Club der Visionäre and Else on the water barely have a door at all while the summer season lasts.
